action_catalog.display_name: Fifth Ruin Form: Domain of Collapse

effects.evidence: A 60-foot emanation centered on you for the duration.

Hostile creatures in the area cannot regain HP on the same turn they take Ruin damage from you; a hostile creature in the area that casts or activates a technique with Concentration makes a Constitution saving throw or takes Ruin damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus d10.
At the end of each of your turns while the domain persists, suffer one cost.
effects.name: Fifth Ruin Form: Domain of Collapse

effects.evidence: If the domain ends because your Concentration breaks, suffer Ruin Backlash twice.

riders: Fifth Ruin Form: Domain of Collapse -- summoned creatures and map structures within 60 feet (barriers, wards, walls, doors) take Cultivation Level Ruin damage at the start of each of your turns. Anything else the text counts as a structure -- a temporary qi structure, or a non-Secret defensive effect -- is worked out by hand.

Fifth Ruin Form: Domain of Collapse -- the Constitution save also catches a creature that keeps sustaining a Concentration technique it started before it entered the area. The game asks when one is cast or activated there, so a creature already inside is worked out by hand.

zone_spec.name: Fifth Ruin Form: Domain of Collapse

effects.evidence: The next time before the duration ends that you hit with that Channel, deal additional Ruin damage based on your Realm.

action_catalog.display_name: Let go of the bound weapon

parameters.description: Bind Weapon: let go of the weapon bound to the enemy's blade (no Action); the bind and its grapple end, and the weapon falls at the binder's feet.
Use your Action to make Unarmed Strike attacks against a reachable object or structure, applying its defenses and damage rules.
Utilize: a Wisdom (Medicine) check against the fencer's Cultivation Save DC ends a choking creature's Bleed Air.
Utilize: wipe away the blood or dust of a Face Strike from yourself or a creature within 5 feet; its Blinded ends.

choices.name: Opportunity Attack
choices.when: when an enemy leaves your reach
